title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1661: War of extermination (1)

section.p: A single roar by Great Qin King was the sole declaration for the start of a new war.

With one step, both Great Qin King and Great Zhou King split space apart and moved toward the center of the realm. They were headed straight toward the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor, a Daofuse expert.
That was someone they must kill.
“You have gone mad!”

The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor had an unsightly expression. This was madness! How dare the humans invade them? But apart from anger, he was also feeling greatly disturbed. This was extremely troublesome. Humanity had deployed over thirty Invincibles for this operation.

Meanwhile, there were only around twenty Invincibles among the celestial chasms, even after including their slumbering ancient experts. The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor did not intend to fight this war alone. It would be pointless as even in the event of a victory, the celestial chasm race would still be finished.
A large River of Time spread across the sky.
He had to notify the myriad races of this invasion!
But right at that moment, a second River of Time spread across the sky. It was Silk Destroying King. He had never looked so solemn before as he faced his difficult task.
In the blink of an eye, his River of Time spread everywhere.

When Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor’s River of Time attempted to pierce through Silk Destroying King’s River of Time, it failed. Even so, the impact still caused Silk Destroying King to shake as a mouthful of blood spurted out of his mouth.
Too strong.
This was too strong an opponent for him.
Just a single attempt was already enough to shake his power of laws. Even someone proficient at the manipulation of time like him was finding this task incredibly difficult.
Further above in the sky, Great Han King was manifesting one character after another to form a large barrier between Great Zhou King’s barrier and the net of rivers formed by Silk Destroying King.

With this, the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor would not be able to notify the outside world before piercing through all three barriers. With a snort, the Pseudo Emperor sent his River of Time forward again.
Just then, a massive spear soared into the sky.
“Kill!”
Great Qin King’s roar rang out with a backdrop of falling moons.
The various human Invincibles were unleashed, eradicating all life in their path.
This was a war of extermination.
The fate and fortune of an entire race was the wager for this operation.
Upon defeat, humanity’s fortune would decline.

Upon victory, humanity would obtain a stronger position among the myriad races. Even the divines, devils, immortals, and dragons would need to start thinking twice before doing anything against humanity.
The sky split apart as the spear started shooting toward the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor.

With a snort by the Pseudo Emperor, the entire realm shook as a dark beam of light instantly appeared and twirled itself around the spear. Then, it started corroding the saber that was being used as a spear. The Source Return Blade was a divine weapon, but even so, it started smoking from the corrosive power of the dark beam.
Nevertheless, it was still a divine weapon.
As the saber resisted, the spear qi around it shone even brighter than before, radiating an intense killing intent.

“Qin Guang, have you considered the consequences of this?” The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor threatened, “This is the Celestial Chasm Realm. Don’t force my hand. At worst, I’ll shatter the realm barrier and free the Death Realm. All of us will die together. Do you want all these human experts to die with us?”
Great Qin King said nothing. The threat meant nothing. He was here on a mission.
The spear continued shooting toward the Pseudo Emperor.
“Hmph! A Daofuse is so much more than you understand!”

The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor was furious. Far away, the various Invincibles were already busy fighting each other. Thanks to their numerical superiority, the humans had the upper hand in the battle even with several celestial chasm fossils joining the battle. At this rate, it would only be a matter of time before the celestial chasms were defeated.
The only way to turn the situation around was to eliminate both Great Qin King and Great Zhou King as soon as possible. Without the two, the other humans would not be able to secure victory.
“Die, Qin Guang!”

With a roar by the Pseudo Emperor, the entire realm shook yet again. Then, a burst of incorporeal power emerged, passing through the various powers and source qi in the air before striking Great Qin King’s sea of willpower.
This was one of the curses the celestial chasms were famous for.
Great Qin King’s expression did not change, but he couldn’t stop his blood from flowing out of his seven orifices. Then again, he wasn’t too bothered. It wasn’t like he knew nothing about curses.
After all, he had prior experience fighting the celestial chasms. These curses wouldn’t do much to him.
His spear continued shooting forward. To deal with these curses, he only needed to maintain one thought in his mind: not to withdraw his spear before piercing through the Pseudo Emperor.
Defending would be pointless when fighting Daofuses.
He could only go all out on the offensive.
Betting everything on offense, cutting his opponent’s path of retreat off with the sheer intensity of his attacks.
He was doing this out of necessity. He had to sacrifice something if he wanted to put up a fight against someone stronger than him.
“Die!”
Offense was his sole answer here.

With that roar, Great Qin King’s killing intent grew even more. Noticing the growing intensity of the incoming attack, the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor’s expression changed slightly. He snorted and instantly erected numerous barriers before him.
A few human Invincibles wanted to help Great Qin King, but Great Zhou King stopped them, “No. Join hands and kill the other celestial chasm Eternals. Make it quick. We don’t have much time here.”
There was no need for them to help.
Great Zhou King himself and Great Qin King would be the ones dealing with the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor.

The rest of them only needed to focus on killing the other celestial chasm Invincibles. And to finish the job quickly, they had to rely on their numerical superiority. Otherwise, only a suicidal fighting style would be able to accomplish the task of finishing the battle quickly.
At that, the human Invincibles pulled back and rejoined the battle against the celestial chasm Invincibles.

At this point, the Invincibles were devoid of any other thoughts except killing. The battle increased in intensity as the sky collapsed and the earth turned into dust. Black holes appeared everywhere while shockwaves spread throughout the realm.
Countless celestial chasms in the central region of the Celestial Chasm Realm died.
Moons rained down from the sky.

Noticing the destruction unfolding in their home, the celestial chasms grew even more desperate. With a roar, about seven or eight celestial chasm Pseudo Invincibles descended from the sky and started setting up a massive formation. The formation gave off an ominous sensation, as though they were attempting to establish a connection with a terrifying existence.
“With my blood, I curse humanity!”
One after another, they roared. A thick clump of death qi appeared out of nowhere, first corroding the bodies of its summoners before shooting toward one of the human Invincibles fighting in the sky.
As the death qi struck, the flesh of the human Invincible started rotting away.
Instantly, the human Invincible was reduced to fine powder before turning into three different bodies.
One of them crumbled apart right after appearing.
The two remaining bodies shot down unhesitatingly and attacked the Pseudo Invincibles on the ground.
After several explosions, all the Pseudo Invincibles died. Alas, the human Invincible was left with only one blood-soaked and deathly pale body.
The battle had barely started, yet it had reached an incredibly high level of intensity.
Both sides were aware that this was a battle of extermination.
No hesitation was allowed in such a battle. Nobody could afford to hold back.

Pseudo Invincibles weren’t necessarily weak as some were capable of fighting even Invincibles. Unfortunately for the celestial chasms, their strongest Pseudo Invincible, Heavencurse, had been killed by Su Yu. That was a super Pseudo Invincible capable of defeating even regular Invincibles.

Somewhere in the sky, a celestial chasm Invincible was fighting three human Invincibles alone. In the blink of an eye, he was injured so much his three bodies were forced to split. In his desperation, he released a burst of death qi and roared, “With my body as the price, I lay upon you the curse of eternal damnation!”
As he said that, all three of his bodies burned.
He knew that his death was near.
The humans were clearly here to exterminate their race.

He would die no matter what. The celestial chasm race might also cease to exist after this. He grew even more sure of his fate after being forced to split his three bodies. Since he would die, he would not go down silently. Anyone capable of reaching the Invincible Realm would have such decisiveness.

Right after he released his curse, the human Invincible who had just lost two of his bodies was greeted by a clump of incomparably powerful and sinister death qi. The clump of death qi covered his entire body before he could even react.
“Ning Hong!”
Someone exclaimed in alarm.

That was a rather new human Invincible who had affirmed his dao in a minor realm. He wasn’t too strong, which was why even Pseudo Invincibles could cause him to lose two bodies. With the new curse laid on him, his entire body started burning.

A look of pain covered his face as death qi leaked out of his burning body. A curse laid by an Invincible with the life of the said Invincible as the price was too much for him to handle, especially in his current state.

Noticing that some people were moving over to help him, he gnashed his teeth and smiled, “You can’t save me. My sea of willpower is breaking down. I’m too weak. I was too cowardly. I only dared to affirm my dao in a minor realm. Because of that cowardly decision, I have been stuck for so many years. I am an embarrassment to humanity.”
With a hearty laugh, he roared, “Great Tang King, kill!”
Not far away, the furious Great Tang King threw a fist toward the Invincible he was facing.
At the same time, Ning Hong shot toward Great Tang King’s opponent. Before the enemy Invincible could react, Ning Hong stabbed through the enemy Invincible’s body.
Next, Great Tang King’s fist arrived, blasting the enemy Invincible apart.
The Invincible returned from a shaking River of Time, only to be greeted by another punch of Great Yang King. He was instantly blasted apart.
The same thing repeated again.
The River of Time snapped.
Crimson clouds covered the sky.
